# Materials {#sec-materials}

Materials are items of type *material* (Q5). Works link to them with the property *Material* (P10). Where available, materials are connected to Wikidata (P24) or the Art & Architecture Thesaurus (P26).

```{python}
#| label: setup
from baldessari import cps, plots, table
materials = cps.materials()
```

The CPS Wikibase describes **`{python} len(materials)`** materials, of which **`{python} int((materials["works"] > 0).sum())`** are used by at least one work.

```{python}
#| label: fig-materials
#| fig-cap: "The most frequently used materials."
plots.bar_counts(materials.head(15), "label", "works")
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-materials
#| tbl-cap: "Materials, number of works and external identifiers."
shown = materials[["qid", "label", "works", "wikidata", "aat"]]
shown.columns = ["ID", "Material", "Works", "Wikidata", "AAT"]
table(shown)
```
